channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: Bruce Springsteen Delivers First Live Performance of ICE Protest Song in Minneapolis
item.description: "This is for the people of Minneapolis, Minnesota, and the people of our good country, the United States of America," Springsteen said before he sang the track.

item.title: Jakops, the Producer Behind XG, on What’s Next for Pop Group After ‘The Core’
item.description: The mogul, who's moving to the U.S., says "I think now is finally our moment" after the stars released their first full-length studio album.

item.title: Inside Grammy Gift Bags: From Nipple Covers and Shower Heads to Cosmetic Enhancements
item.description: L.A.-based entertainment marketing company Distinctive Assets, headed by Lash Fary, returns for a 26th year to handle swag for presenters and performers as a way of saying thank you for participating.

item.title: Jordin Sparks Speaks Out After Viral Post Asking Halle Berry to Read Her Menopause Screenplay
item.description: "I wrote a screenplay about hormones and menopause and know you'd be the right person to talk to about it!" Sparks posted in a public message to the Oscar winner.

item.title: Film Students Are Having Trouble Sitting Through Movies, Professors Say
item.description: Watching a film for class used to be a dream assignment.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney on “MAGA Barbie” Nickname: “I’ve Never Been Here to Talk About Politics”
item.description: "I’ve always been here to make art, so this is just not a conversation I want to be at the forefront of," the 'Christy' star said in conversation with Cosmopolitan.

item.title: 2026 Oscars to Feature Live Performances From Only Two Best Original Song Nominees
item.description: "Golden" from 'KPop Demon Hunters' and "I Lied to You" from 'Sinners' will be included in the awards ceremony, with the other nominees introduced via custom-produced segments and receiving support across social media.
